tool_schemas.name: airbnb_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a location-based Airbnb search (using `placeId` if provided, otherwise `location`) with optional stay context and price filters, persists the query plus the returned page cursor, and returns the current page of listing snapshots with a `cursor` to request the next page (omit `cursor` to start a new search). Results are paged exclusively via the base64 `cursor`; an invalid/expired cursor is rejected rather than partially served. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when required fields are missing or malformed (e.g., bad date format, `checkout` <= `checkin`, negative guest counts, `minPrice` > `maxPrice`), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to run searches or to set `ignoreRobotsText`, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the underlying Airbnb fetch fails.

location.description: Location to search for (city, state, etc.)

placeId.description: Google Maps Place ID (overrides the location parameter)

ignoreRobotsText.description: Ignore robots.txt rules for this request

tool_schemas.name: airbnb_listing_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and stores a versioned, detailed snapshot for the given Airbnb listing `id` in the provided stay/guest context (dates and guest counts), and returns the latest fetched detail snapshot along with a direct link to the listing. If the same `id` is requested again with the same context, we return the most recently stored snapshot; changing context (dates/guests) creates a new snapshot version. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT for malformed `id` or invalid context (e.g., bad date format, `checkout` <= `checkin`, negative guest counts), NOT_FOUND when the listing does not exist or is not accessible for the given context, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to fetch listing details or to set `ignoreRobotsText`, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream detail fetch fails.

ignoreRobotsText.description: Ignore robots.txt rules for this request

tool_schemas.name: airbnb_search_queries_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted Airbnb search queries with optional filtering by status, location/placeId, time range, and request fingerprint. Returns results ordered by `created_at` desc and paged via `limit`/`cursor` to support history browsing and debugging; refuses invalid pagination parameters.

location.description: Filter by the stored `location` field (exact match).

placeId.description: Filter by the stored `place_id` field (exact match).

executedAfter.description: Only include queries with `executed_at` >= this ISO-8601 timestamp.

executedBefore.description: Only include queries with `executed_at` <= this ISO-8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: airbnb_search_query_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted Airbnb search query by `id`, including its stored parameters and execution metadata. Refuses unknown ids.

id.description: Primary key of the search query row.

tool_schemas.name: airbnb_search_results_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search results (listing snapshots) for a given `searchQueryId`, ordered by non-negative `rank`. Supports pagination for large result sets and optional filtering by result status; refuses unknown searchQueryId or invalid pagination.

searchQueryId.description: Primary key of the search query whose results to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: airbnb_listings_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists known Airbnb listings in the cache with optional filtering by `airbnbListingId` and lifecycle `status`. Returns rows ordered by `last_seen_at` desc and paged via `limit`/`cursor`; refuses invalid pagination parameters.

airbnbListingId.description: Filter by the upstream Airbnb listing id (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: airbnb_listing_detail_snapshots_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists versioned detail snapshots for a cached listing, optionally filtered by stay/guest context and fetch status. Returns snapshots ordered by `fetched_at` desc and paged via `limit`/`cursor`; refuses unknown listingId or invalid pagination.

listingId.description: Primary key of the cached listing (`airbnb_listings.id`).

adults.description: Filter snapshots by number of adults.

children.description: Filter snapshots by number of children.

infants.description: Filter snapshots by number of infants.

pets.description: Filter snapshots by number of pets.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.
